text: Course Overview: Geological Resources and Geological Engineering is a discipline that studies the exploration and evaluation of geological bodies and the development and utilization of resources. It covers two major fields: resources and environment, and is closely related to the sustainable development of society and economy. This discipline focuses on geological bodies as the research object, including studying the geological background, formation conditions, and formation mechanisms of mineral resources, as well as the theories, methods, and technologies related to engineering geological bodies in engineering exploration, design, and construction.Research Directions: Common research directions include mineral prospecting and exploration, mainly studying the theories and technologies for predicting, exploring, and evaluating solid minerals and energy minerals; earth exploration and information technology, focusing on the effectiveness research and comprehensive application of various exploration technologies and information integration technologies; geological engineering, mainly researching the investigation, evaluation, and monitoring of hydrogeology, engineering geology, environmental geology, and ecological geology.Training Objectives: To cultivate new interdisciplinary innovative talents who can undertake engineering exploration, design, consultation, construction, scientific research, and management work, with a solid theoretical foundation, strong practical innovation ability, broad international vision, and the ability to solve complex geological resources and geological engineering problems.Employment Directions: Graduates can work in departments such as natural resources, energy, water conservancy, and transportation, engaging in mineral resource exploration, evaluation, and development, as well as engineering geological exploration, geological disaster prevention and control, etc.
